messages:
Olivia (Docs): heads-up: nightly linkcheck and TOC generator disagree on anchors for /guides/console -> TOC shows a collapsed entry and the fragment /guides/console#cli-quickstart is 404 in CI
CI-Bot: docs-ci | ERROR: Broken fragment -> /guides/console#cli-quickstart (404)
Olivia (Docs): page heading is: 
```
## CLI quickstart
![CLI screenshot](./img/cli.png "CLI quickstart")
```
Olivia (Docs): looks like the image title is being used by some slugifiers to generate a duplicate anchor, which moves the visible TOC entry. older builds didn't do this
Kai (Eng): reproduces locally with mkdocs-material v8 + mkdocs-autoslug change. The plugin now considers image titles when generating anchor candidates if the preceding heading is short. Annoying edgecase
Fern (Tech Writer): customers that bookmarked #cli-quickstart hit 404 because the slug got de-duplicated to #cli-quickstart-1. We should stabilize by adding an explicit id on the heading and add a redirect for the legacy fragment
Theo (DevEx): also add a CI guard: parse the generated site to detect when visible TOC entries don't match the expected fragment patterns and surface a warning. We can make it non-fatal for 48h while we roll patches
Kai (Eng): quick PR plan: 1) add explicit id to heading, 2) update the image title to avoid duplication, 3) add a redirect mapping in mkdocs.yml, 4) small linkcheck tweak to accept redirects for known legacy fragments. I'll open PR now
Kai (Eng): heading patch: 
```md
## CLI quickstart {#cli-quickstart}
![CLI screenshot](./img/cli.png "CLI quickstart (screenshot)")
```
Kai (Eng): mkdocs.yml redirects snippet (mkdocs-redirects): 
```yaml
plugins:
  - redirects:
      redirects:
        'guides/console/#cli-quickstart': 'guides/console/#cli-quickstart-1'
```
Olivia (Docs): thanks. Fern can you grep for other headings with adjacent images that use the same short title? I can open follow-up PRs for pages I own
Fern (Tech Writer): yes, doing that now. Found 3 similar cases in ../guides and ../tutorials. Will open small fixes after PR merges
CI-Bot: PR 8421 | checks started (docs linkcheck included)
Theo (DevEx): follow-ups: 1) merge PR 8421, 2) deploy, 3) run TOC vs fragment audit next morning and fix any remaining mismatches, 4) add a short note to docs/contrib/heading-image-guidance.md recommending explicit ids when images follow headings
Olivia (Docs): created a tiny migration note and linked PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/8421 (draft) — ping here when CI goes green
Kai (Eng): CI green, merged and deployed. Redirects in place.
CI-Bot: docs-site build | SUCCESS
Olivia (Docs): closing loop. thanks all :thumbsup:
